d: Manage and support project activities, ensuring effective planning, coordination and implementation. Deliver site activities in accordance with agreed schedules and quality standards.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline.
Minimum 6 years of relevant project management experience.
Experience coordinating contractors and managing project planning and implementation.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and data analysis.
Excellent client-facing, internal communication and written reporting skills.
Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously.
r: Plan and manage project activities from implementation through completion.
Develop and maintain project schedules, monitor progress and coordinate activities to meet delivery milestones.
Coordinate with contractors, internal teams and client representatives to ensure effective project execution.
Monitor site activities and address issues affecting delivery schedules or quality.
Ensure adherence to quality standards throughout project execution.
Track project risks, issues and outstanding actions, escalating matters where required.
Prepare project reports and analyse progress data using Microsoft Office.
Maintain accurate project documentation and communicate updates to relevant stakeholders.
